title: Financial Modeling and Valuation
shortDescription: Build a fully linked three-statement model and value a company with DCF and comparables.
description: Learn to build the models analysts use in equity research, investment banking and corporate finance. Starting from historical financials, you will forecast all three statements, link them with debt and cash schedules, and value the business using discounted cash flow, comparable companies and precedent transactions, then stress test the result.
whoFor: Aspiring equity research and investment banking analysts
Corporate finance professionals who build budgets and forecasts
CFA® candidates who want to apply valuation theory in practice
outcomes: Build an integrated three-statement model that balances
Forecast revenue, costs, working capital, capex and debt
Value a company with DCF, trading comparables and precedent transactions
Run sensitivity and scenario analysis and present a valuation range

faq.q: Do I need to take Excel for Finance first?
faq.a: It helps but is not required if you are comfortable with lookups, absolute references and basic financial functions.
A fictional company with realistic, original data so you can focus on technique.
